title: LiveAnalyticsReadResult
description: live.analytics-read-result@1: the answer of GET /internal/analytics-summary?days=1-90 on OpenVibe.Live (capability live.analytics.read): { ok: true, summary } — Live's aggregate traffic totals only, for Network's navigation ordering (which sites are really used), never rows or people. summary is open (it grows with what Live measures). A failure is { ok: false, error }; a caller without the internal key gets 401 { ok: false }.
